name: Orders by email
summary: Takes orders that arrive by email, enters each one as a draft invoice in Xero, and drafts the customer confirmation in Gmail. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

all.evidence: 3 of the 8 retail calls read describe this order flow (health and wellness, food and grocery)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New order emails from Gmail that match the search in settings.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Enter each order with its proposed lines as a DRAFT Xero invoice, draft the Gmail confirmation, and queue its send for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: an email draft, a DRAFT invoice in Xero, a customer record. Sending the confirmation is a live operation and waits for a person.

google-workspace.covers: order email intake, confirmation draft, approved send

xero.covers: item list, customer contact, DRAFT invoice for the order

gaps: Unleashed (sales orders, the usual order record for B2B retail): the enter-order and stock-check operations are mapped (docs.post_SalesOrders, docs.get_StockOnHand) but the kit has no HMAC-SHA256 signer for it yet, and its parameter fields are not mapped, so there is no adapter.
Fishbowl (stock levels): no platform in core/sdk/platforms, so the stock check stays with the owner. Orders are confirmed without a stock check.
MaxShip (booking the parcel and printing the label): no platform in core/sdk/platforms, so pick and dispatch stay with the owner.
Order lines are a judgment step: the agent reads the email and proposes codes and quantities from the Xero item list. Orders with no proposal wait as needs-lines.
The Xero invoice stays a DRAFT. Authorising it and emailing it to the customer are left to the owner in Xero.
The Gmail helper creates drafts without an idempotency key: a crash between creating a draft and queueing its send can leave an unsent orphan draft in the mailbox.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox mailbox and a Xero demo company prove the calls end to end.

evidence.calls: 3 retail order calls describe this flow; 8 retail calls were read for the orders family
evidence.platforms: retail-orders-platforms.json: Gmail, Unleashed and Xero mapped step by step from their own pages and the kit's operation lists
